summary_en: Presents a dual-wavelength ultra-wideband raster-scan optoacoustic mesoscopy system using 515 nm and 532 nm excitation for dynamic, layer-resolved 3D mapping of cutaneous microvascular oxygenation. Human vascular-occlusion experiments demonstrate ischemic decline, hyperemic overshoot, and recovery consistent with expected vascular physiology, extending RSOM from morphology toward quantitative functional imaging.
